`enum SnapshotProfile`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3.snapshot` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [SnapshotProfile.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/snapshot/SnapshotProfile.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The OpenGL contexts on which the snapshot tests of LWJGL 3 run, each a version, a profile and the extensions it hides.

## Description

On Mesa, `MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE` and `MESA_GLSL_VERSION_OVERRIDE` give the version that a profile needs.

## Learn more

- [OpenGL profiles](/build/backends/lwjgl3/#opengl-profiles)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`DEFAULT`](#SnapshotProfile-value-DEFAULT) | The context of `CORE_33`, whatever its version: the profile of a plain test run. |
| [`GL_20`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_20) | OpenGL 2.0 compatibility with GLSL 1.10, which JOID refuses: it tests that registering the backend throws. |
| [`GL_21`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_21) | OpenGL 2.1 compatibility, the oldest context that JOID draws on. |
| [`GL_21_EXT`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_21_EXT) | OpenGL 2.1 without `GL_ARB_framebuffer_object` and `GL_ARB_vertex_array_object`: the EXT framebuffers and no vertex arrays. |
| [`GL_21_EXT_NO_BLIT`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_21_EXT_NO_BLIT) | `GL_21_EXT` without `GL_EXT_framebuffer_blit` either: the mipmaps are drawn. |
| [`GL_30`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_30) | OpenGL 3.0 compatibility. |
| [`GL_32_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_32_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE) | OpenGL 3.2 forward-compatible core. |
| [`GL_33`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_33) | OpenGL 3.3 core. |
| [`GL_45_COMPATIBILITY`](#SnapshotProfile-value-GL_45_COMPATIBILITY) | OpenGL 4.5 compatibility, with the fixed pipeline next to the shaders. |
